title: Endpoint DLP API families in the SDKs and Terraform provider

families.statement: The Go SDK manages Endpoint DLP as separate families, each with its own path: the application catalog and custom applications (`/endPointApplications`), application groups (`/endPointApplicationGroups`), endpoint resources (`/dlpEndpointResource`), resource groups (`/endPointDlpResourceGroups`), and rules with their exception (sub) rules (`/endPointDlpRules`).

release-note-sub-rules.statement: The Go SDK release notes list Endpoint DLP exception (sub) rule create, update and delete under `/endPointDlpRules/{id}/subRule`.

quotes: Adds a new exception (sub) rule to an existing Endpoint DLP rule.
Deletes the Endpoint DLP exception (sub) rule based on the specified IDs.

resource-channels.statement: Endpoint resources are grouped by four channels, PRINTING, REMOVABLE_DRIVE_TRANSFER, NETWORK_DRIVE_TRANSFER and PERSONAL_CLOUD_STORAGE, and channel-scoped reads take one of those values in the path.

go-aggregates-pages.statement: The Go SDK's endpoint application list functions page through the results themselves, requesting 5000 per page.

python-single-page.statement: The Python SDK's endpoint application list issues one request and returns that response's current page, so it does not reproduce the Go aggregation; callers must page themselves.
python-single-page.conditions: Read of the Python list function, which sends one request and decodes `response.get_results()`; contrasted with the Go function in go-aggregates-pages. Same pattern as the shared SDK pagination subject.

evidence.after: Lists the endpoint applications configured in your organization.

python-unified-client-only.statement: The Endpoint DLP accessors are registered on the unified Python `ZIAService` client and not on the legacy client.
python-unified-client-only.conditions: Rests on an absence: `grep -n -i endpoint vendor/zscaler-sdk-python/zscaler/zia/legacy.py` returns no Endpoint DLP property, while zia_service.py defines them.

python-custom-app-model-mixup.statement: In the Python SDK, custom-app list and get decode `EndpointApplicationsCustomApps`, but create and update declare and decode `DlpEndpointResource`. This is an SDK wrapper defect, not evidence of the endpoint's wire schema.

go-request-serializer.statement: The Go shared endpoint-application request serializer sends only non-empty `resourceId` and `zappId`, because the API rejects writes that carry the read-only `version` and `versions` objects.

go-versions-shape-differs.statement: The shared Go model types `versions` as one `Versions` struct, while the custom-application response model types the same wire key as a list; the two response shapes are not interchangeable.

terraform-resources.statement: Terraform provider v4.8.0 added Endpoint DLP custom applications, application groups, resources, resource groups, rules and sub-rules, plus data sources for applications, rules, channels and resource group tags. Release context: Go SDK v3.8.41 and Python SDK v1.9.39 introduced the families (Python registers them in v1.9.41 too); Terraform v4.8.0 added the provider side.

quotes: Added the resource and data source `zia_endpoint_dlp_custom_apps`
Added the resource and data source `zia_endpoint_dlp_rules`
Added the resource `zia_endpoint_dlp_resource_group` - Creates and manages Endpoint DLP resource groups (tags).
Added the data source `zia_dlp_endpoint_resource_group_tag` - Retrieves DLP endpoint resource tags defined for a channel.
Added the resource `zia_endpoint_dlp_resource` - Creates and manages Endpoint DLP resources.

outside-automate-capture.statement: The Endpoint DLP families are outside the current Automate API capture, so their fields cannot be checked against the vendor contract; they exist as Go SDK and Terraform surface only.

quotes: Official client/provider families that cannot yet be reconciled field by field because no corresponding operation is mapped in the current Automate capture:

tenant-entitlement.title: Whether a tenant is entitled to Endpoint DLP and these endpoints
tenant-entitlement.blocks: assuming the API families work on a given tenant because the client has them
tenant-entitlement.detail: Client presence does not establish entitlement or live rollout; the call result on the tenant does.

application-response-fields.title: Endpoint application response fields are not enumerated here
application-response-fields.detail: The legacy doc listed the descriptive, OS, file, signature, type and version fields of endpoint-application responses. Dropped as SDK field mapping; read the Go struct EndPointApplications in zscaler/zia/services/common/common.go.
